changeSet.author: ${claude}
changeSet.comment:
The Overview series stops adding up every lot ever bought, which counted money twice once it left one position for another (issue #509). Each row is one event in its wallet's own currency, split into own money and reinvested profit, and across a user's wallets the two add up to the cost basis plus the cash, so the series ends exactly at the Overview's Total investido plus cash.
Own money is a purchase's new money from the cash replay, transfers in minus transfers out and withdrawals to the bank, plus two corrections that keep the total exact. A reinvestment adds its lot's purchase_amount and takes away its exit's net amount, which cancel. A move's destination lot adds its purchase_amount, which is set only on lots written before purchase_amount existed: since then the origin keeps the moved cost in its own purchase_amount. Reinvested profit is every exit's profit, reinvestments included.
changeSet.sql:
DROP VIEW finances.contributions_timeline;
CREATE VIEW finances.capital_timeline AS SELECT wallets.id AS wallet_id, wallets.user_id, date_trunc('month', replay.event_date::TIMESTAMP)::DATE AS month, CASE replay.event_type WHEN 'TRANSFER_IN' THEN replay.amount WHEN 'TRANSFER_OUT' THEN -replay.amount WHEN 'CASH_WITHDRAWAL' THEN -replay.amount ELSE replay.new_money END AS own_money_amount, 0::NUMERIC AS reinvested_profit_amount, COALESCE(currency_rates.rate, 1) AS rate FROM finances.wallets CROSS JOIN LATERAL finances.wallet_cash_replay(wallets.id) AS replay LEFT JOIN finances.currency_rates ON currency_rates.currency_code = wallets.currency WHERE replay.event_type <> 'WITHDRAWAL'
UNION ALL
SELECT wallets.id, wallets.user_id, date_trunc('month', stock_lots.lot_date::TIMESTAMP)::DATE, stock_lots.purchase_amount, 0::NUMERIC, COALESCE(currency_rates.rate, 1) FROM finances.stock_lots JOIN finances.stock_holdings ON stock_holdings.id = stock_lots.stock_holding_id JOIN finances.wallets ON wallets.id = stock_holdings.wallet_id LEFT JOIN finances.currency_rates ON currency_rates.currency_code = wallets.currency WHERE stock_lots.origin IN ('MOVE', 'REINVESTMENT') AND stock_lots.purchase_amount IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT wallets.id, wallets.user_id, date_trunc('month', crypto_lots.lot_date::TIMESTAMP)::DATE, crypto_lots.purchase_amount, 0::NUMERIC, COALESCE(currency_rates.rate, 1) FROM finances.crypto_lots JOIN finances.crypto_holdings ON crypto_holdings.id = crypto_lots.crypto_holding_id JOIN finances.wallets ON wallets.id = crypto_holdings.wallet_id LEFT JOIN finances.currency_rates ON currency_rates.currency_code = wallets.currency WHERE crypto_lots.origin IN ('MOVE', 'REINVESTMENT') AND crypto_lots.purchase_amount IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT wallets.id, wallets.user_id, date_trunc('month', fund_contributions.contribution_date::TIMESTAMP)::DATE, fund_contributions.purchase_amount, 0::NUMERIC, COALESCE(currency_rates.rate, 1) FROM finances.fund_contributions JOIN finances.fund_holdings ON fund_holdings.id = fund_contributions.fund_holding_id JOIN finances.wallets ON wallets.id = fund_holdings.wallet_id LEFT JOIN finances.currency_rates ON currency_rates.currency_code = wallets.currency WHERE fund_contributions.origin IN ('MOVE', 'REINVESTMENT') AND fund_contributions.purchase_amount IS NOT NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT wallets.id, wallets.user_id, date_trunc('month', results.result_date::TIMESTAMP)::DATE, CASE WHEN results.result_type = 'REINVESTMENT' THEN -results.net_amount ELSE 0 END, results.profit, COALESCE(currency_rates.rate, 1) FROM finances.results LEFT JOIN finances.stock_holdings ON stock_holdings.id = results.stock_holding_id LEFT JOIN finances.crypto_holdings ON crypto_holdings.id = results.crypto_holding_id LEFT JOIN finances.fund_holdings ON fund_holdings.id = results.fund_holding_id JOIN finances.wallets ON wallets.id = COALESCE( stock_holdings.wallet_id, crypto_holdings.wallet_id, fund_holdings.wallet_id ) LEFT JOIN finances.currency_rates ON currency_rates.currency_code = wallets.currency;
